role: translation eliminating source primitive possibility into the host defined dual
notes: The translation fixes atoms constants and boxes and commutes with Boolean connectives.

role: local finite-sequence consequence with only theorem-level modal replacement
notes: Premises are true at one world; every RE equivalence needs a separate proof without those premises.

role: source formula dual and dual modality word
notes: The formula dual negates atoms and swaps Boolean duals; the word dual swaps box and diamond while retaining negation.

role: formula truth set in a neighborhood model
notes: Source truth sets are propositions in the powerset of worlds.

role: powerset necessity operation and its complement dual
notes: The operation determines neighborhood membership and conversely; iteration uses composition.

role: supplementation nonempty finite intersection closure and quasi-filtering of a family
notes: Intersection arity is positive; supplementation and this intersection closure commute.

role: Chellas axiom-schema identifiers for three independent neighborhood properties
notes: These names identify schemas; the source also uses M as a system name with its separately declared type.

role: source smallest monotonic regular and normal systems
notes: Proved names are M equals EM; R equals EMC; K equals EMCN. System names are distinct typed roles from same-letter schemas.

role: classical extension selected by a subset of the M C N schema names
notes: The selected family has eight systems; it is not the full lattice of modal logics.

role: source implication binary regular and finite normal theorem rules
notes: The normal rule includes zero antecedents; all rules apply to theorems.

role: world set of maximal consistent theories in a classical system
notes: Existence uses the countable enumeration and local deduction argument; base systems are proved consistent.

role: Chellas published proof set consisting of maximal worlds containing A
notes: This source-local bar notation is a proposition set not cardinality; it differs from the logical equivalence class.

role: family of all formula proof sets in the canonical world set
notes: Non-proof subsets are those outside this family; changing their membership may affect structural frame conditions.

role: smallest and largest canonical neighborhood choices
notes: The smallest includes forced proof sets only; the largest additionally includes all non-proof subsets.

role: principal neighborhood family of an accessibility relation
notes: Contains exactly the supersets of the successor set; an empty successor set gives all subsets.

role: core of a world's neighborhood family
notes: Empty-family intersection is the whole world domain; an augmented family contains its core and every superset.

role: finite subformula observation set quotient worlds and quotient map
notes: A required unit is retained by adding the boxed truth observation; all observed proposition sets are saturated.

role: the 1980 source minimal model with a sequence of atom valuations
notes: Source P at index n is the host valuation of atom p at index n; the source permits empty world sets.

role: arbitrary unary modal operation on a Boolean algebra
notes: This semantic unary operation is distinct from the formula and modality-word dual transformations.

role: logical equivalence class in the source Lindenbaum modal algebra construction
notes: Equivalent exactly when the formula biconditional is a theorem; RE makes its boxed class well defined.

role: finite Boolean subalgebra greatest-lower-bound projection and projected modal operation
notes: Only represented modal outputs need exact agreement; projection preserves each M C N inequality.

role: finite iterates of the necessity and possibility operations
notes: The zeroth iterate is identity; the diamond iterate is complement then the box iterate then complement.

role: source neighborhood-property names corresponding to schemas D T B 4 5
notes: These are conditions on proposition families; no undeclared relational accessibility properties are substituted.

role: maximal source theories in the explicit smallest-E5 counterexample
notes: The first lacks boxed truth; the indexed identity theories are pairwise distinct and define the diagonal non-proof set.

role: finite complement-closed proposition family used in the ET5 non-normality witness
notes: Its induced operation fixes these six sets and sends every other set to empty.
